adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `minimumTokenResponseSchema` is defined with computed property keys like `[z.string().toString()]: z.number()`. At runtime this produces a literal property name from `ZodString#toString()` (i.e., a garbage/static key), not an “any string key” constraint, so the schema does not actually model “any numeric expiry field” and won’t validate arbitrary token responses as intended in credential-sharing mode. This is a real correctness defect in the new logic (Zod should use `.catchall(...)`/`.passthrough()` or `z.record(...)` patterns instead).
